propositions: Pure single-pass evidence-prepacked verification produces false-positive rejections on imperfect packs; a narrowed agentic fallback over abstained criteria mitigates this by construction.

The filter (one LLM call, no tools) may only PASS with citations or ABSTAIN per criterion, never FAIL; the fallback reruns agentic verify_completion scoped to abstained ACs via AC-block reduction at ticket load.

Filter coverage is bimodal by AC style: greppable artifacts (symbols, test functions, file paths) achieve ~90% pass rate; runtime outcomes and store-side assertions rationally abstain (~0% on epics/tasks).

Combined filter+fallback consumed 26% fewer input tokens than pure-agentic on 6 tickets (real+adversarial variants); real all-met corpus alone saw 46% token savings while maintaining zero false-positive passes on 5 planted-unmet ACs.
Correctness holds: all 5 adversarial unmet ACs abstained at filter and were failed by fallback; all real variants verified PASS/PASS; no false passes occurred on filter-passed criteria.
Residual risks are agentic false-FAIL variance (low but present) and coverage instability on runtime-outcome AC styles; productivity gain is highest for test-citing ACs (60-80% cost savings).
